title: Documentation website audit
command: Audit these Katara documentation pages for gaps, contradictions, and broken links. Distinguish observed defects from suggestions.
description: Three section specialists each delegate to two page researchers.

specialists.title: Onboarding reviewer
specialists.goal: Check whether first-time users can follow the setup.

researchers.title: API page reviewer
researchers.question: Check setup prerequisites, command completeness, and observed links.

researchers.title: Chat page reviewer
researchers.question: Check sign-in, network context, and observed links.

specialists.title: Concept reviewer
specialists.goal: Compare model behavior and network descriptions.

researchers.title: Katara Cortex reviewer
researchers.question: Look for unsupported claims and ambiguities using the supplied pages.

researchers.title: Network reviewer
researchers.question: Check chain, token, and environment wording for consistency.

researchers.title: Error reviewer
researchers.question: Check failure and retry guidance and observed link outcomes.

researchers.title: Usage reviewer
researchers.question: Check cost fields and attribution descriptions against the model guide.
